DaemonDescription.description:
A started Daemon, as a test and `goodfetch-test-env`'s description see
it: what a Client needs to reach it.

console.description:
The URL of the Console it serves, `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/` on a
port of its own; `None` when it serves none.

socket.description:
Where it listens: its Unix socket's path on macOS and Linux, its
loopback TCP address (`127.0.0.1:<port>`) on Windows (ADR 0024).

token.description: The per-launch token a Client's `hello` carries.

ProvingGroundDescription.description:
A started Proving ground, as a test and `goodfetch-test-env`'s
description see it.

address.description: The address `serve` bound and answers on, such as `127.0.0.1:51234`.

ca.description:
The file of the certificate authority its TLS leaves chain to, as
PEM, in the test's folder.

fixtures.description: The addresses of its network fixtures.

resolve.description:
Every host name it serves, mapped to the IP of its address, as the
`resolve` setting takes them.

seed.description: The seed every page and expected result comes from.

ProvingGroundFixtures.description: The network fixtures `serve` starts beside its pages.

connections.description:
The URL of the connection record, which lists every connection
accepted and every relay a proxy made.

proxies.description:
Each forward proxy's address, by name: `open`, `refusing_tunnels`,
`down` (nothing listens), and one per proxy kind behind Basic
authentication.

proxy_credentials.description: The credentials the authenticated proxies accept.

target.description: The watched target's address, which answers `200 reached`.

udp.description:
The UDP fixture's address, whose every datagram the connection
record lists.

ProxyCredentials.description: A forward proxy's Basic credentials, derived from the seed.

Tools.description:
The commit's executables, each present when its crate exists in the
workspace. Tests of a Product's executable crate use its
`CARGO_BIN_EXE_` path instead.

conformance.description:
`goodfetch-conformance`, whose `read` loads a result document
through `goodfetch-protocol`'s reader.

stub_gateway.description:
`goodfetch-stub-gateway`, the Stub gateway the Console conformance
suite runs against (ADR 0096).

description: One test's setup, as the TypeScript and Python packages read it.

daemon.description:
The Daemon `--daemon` started in the test's home, present only when
asked for.

env.description: The cleared environment of every child the test starts.

folder.description:
The test's own folder, whose name holds a space and a non-ASCII
letter; removed when the test ends.

home.description: `<folder>/home`, the `GOODFETCH_HOME` of everything the test starts.

proving_ground.description:
The Proving ground `--proving-ground <seed>` started, present only
when asked for.

seed.description: The test's seed, at most 2^53 - 1 so every language reads it exactly.

start_time.description: The test's start time, RFC 3339 in UTC.

tools.description: The commit's executables, from the test tool manifest.
